author: JohnSmith000
quote:
DEI Woke ****

First of all, a game has to be fun — and this one isn’t.
While media reviews are LOCKED at a perfect 10.0, gamers’ reviews tell a much more honest story.

We PAID to play this game.

Those fu*king scumbags pushing the DEI agenda have no business telling us how things should be.
We DESERVE choices in OUR games and a good story, just like in GTA V.

Instead, the game has been ruined.

Story aside, the gameplay itself might deserve an 8.0 or so.
Nevertheless, it DOESN'T deserve a unanimous 10.0, and it ISN'T the best game of the generation.

NEVER AGAIN will I spend a single cent on R*.
